name: house-rules
description: Quietly enforces Paddy's writing rules: no em dashes in chat, files or outbound messages, and a nudge when replies run long.

lengthThreshold.title: Length threshold
lengthThreshold.description: Words of prose in one reply before Claude gets a quiet nudge to be shorter. Fenced code and tables do not count.

exemptPaths.title: Exempt paths
exemptPaths.description: File globs where em dashes are allowed in written files, for example docs/quotes/*.md. Empty by default.

outboundTools.title: Outbound tools
outboundTools.description: Tool-name patterns (* is a wildcard) treated as outbound. Em dashes in their text fields are swapped for a spaced hyphen. Leave empty to use the built-in list (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Plain, ClickUp).
